content.scenario: Rahul filed a complaint against a company with the District Commission. After negotiations, the parties reached a settlement, and the Commission received the settlement report. Within how many days must the District Commission pass a suitable order recording the settlement?
content.outcome: The District Commission shall pass a suitable order recording the settlement within seven days of the receipt of the settlement report.
